AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.

2. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.

5. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.

6. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.

11. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

13. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

14. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
